swing_ideas.text: Huge cup and handle with flat top breakout level at 153.60. All time high would be the target around 177.8. If the weekly consolidation holds, this will remain on radar.

Ascending triangle with a flat top breakout to blue sky territory. Simple watch over 48.4. In play as long as the daily 50 SMA (blue) and support trend line holds.

This is all that hit the scanner this week! As always quality over quantity.

sections: S&P weekly chart – Green bodied hammer looks below the prior inverted hammer low, supports over the prior resistance, and closes in the upper third of this weeks range. All of this happening above the aVWAPs, 38.2 fib, HVN... Bullish.

S&P daily chart – Markets gapped up on Friday with the big labor report beat, and were able to close over the daily balance range. The four equalish highs are weak, and if tested should allow for a blue sky breakout. Bears only have strength on the daily below 565.25.

S&P hourly chart – Pathing ideas prior to the Thursday CPI report. Brigade Bolts™ over 574.4 of any kind are blue sky. Holds over 572 is bullish consolidation. In the range we get chop. Under 565.25 sellers win. A failed ATH breakout, with lower high under 572 is bearish.

Market internals – Buyers were able to provide a gap fill reversal, however, there wasn't a ton of strength on the rally into the end of the day. Volume not substantial, advance decline line never in trend higher zone, negative index score build, negative cumulative build.

Market profile – Value really only got overlapping to up, and the point of control did not migrate higher with price into the close. It technically stayed inside of the prior two day balance from Wednesday / Thursday.
